plans.text: Focus on building a broad understanding of Python first, then explore data science and machine learning.
Explore more resources for problem-solving and coding challenges.
Track coding progress by logging completed challenges, learned concepts, and improved skills, and set specific goals with target counts and timeframes.
Complete a few personal projects, such as a simple web scraper or a chatbot.
Start contributing to open-source projects and collaborate with other developers on coding challenges.

preferences.text: Finds the Pomodoro Technique helpful for staying focused on coding exercises.
Thinks Habitica and WakaTime could be useful.
Finds that seeing progress and achieving small victories helps stay motivated.
Reminds themself why they started learning to code to improve their skills and open up new opportunities.
